limitations.note: The rewrite still registers the dispensing outputs on the rising edge instead of decoding the current state and selection combinationally.

limitations.quote: credit <= inserted; // New coins start the next purchase.
limitations.note: Replacing the FSM with a credit counter and change queue altered transaction behavior, including counting both simultaneous inputs instead of giving d1 priority and carrying coins from the dispensing edge into the next purchase.

The test used the rewrite’s own balance and change rules as its oracle and checked dispensing only after rising edges, so its pass did not verify that the outputs respond to a selection change between edges.
Enumerating the reachable credit and change states sized the replacement design but did not help diagnose the original output-timing defect.

limitations.quote: rm -f style commands are not permitted. Use a safer approach
limitations.note: The cleanup command caused the tool to reject the entire simulation invocation, so the test had to be submitted again.
